items.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
items.note: A Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses key-value memory across loops and depths, and its U-shaped variant improves pretraining efficiency and inference latency.

items.title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence

days.summary: Top-voted papers on Hugging Face Daily Papers today: a fully open model family, harder benchmarks for coding agents, and a new defense against prompt injection.

items.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
items.note: Six fully open models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B mixture-of-experts. Good for seeing how a whole model family is designed and trained.

items.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees
items.note: Realistic software assignments, from clarifying the task to handing it off. Current coding agents complete few of them.

items.title: SPILLWAY: Defending Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
items.note: Separates deciding what an agent may act on from cleaning its inputs, to stop hidden instructions in web pages and documents.

items.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
items.note: An AI reviewer trained with reinforcement learning to find soundness problems in research papers.

items.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
items.note: Feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input. A small change to the standard Transformer that makes training more efficient.

items.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552B Parameters
items.note: Tests whether scaling laws also hold for models that control robots.

items.title: MovieRoll: Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
items.note: Keeps streaming video generation stable well past the length it was trained on.

days.summary: Agents everywhere: robotics roadmaps, memory systems for agents, and faster decoding for vision-language models.

items.title: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.note: A survey and roadmap for robots driven by a foundation model plus an agent harness. Easy to read as an overview of the field.

items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.note: Long-term memory for LLM agents without fine-tuning. A close relative of retrieval-augmented generation.

items.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.note: Up to 3.58× faster generation with no loss in output quality, using speculative decoding and sparse attention for long video.

items.title: Loopback Transformer: A Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
items.note: Reuses the same layers in a loop, with finer control over the updates. Beats standard and looped baselines.

items.title: JVT: Just Video Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion
items.note: Video diffusion straight on pixels, with no autoencoder. A clean, minimal design worth reading after DDPM.
